subject: judge-journal schema v2: add shadow_verdict/shadow_conf/model_version fields
description: Add three new optional fields to every judge-journal.jsonl row: shadow_verdict (keep|prune), shadow_conf (0–1 float), model_version (string e.g. "edge-clf-v1"). These are written by the shadow judge runner (phase 3) alongside the Sonnet verdict. The journal writer in daemon.js (the judge verdict handler) should accept and persist these fields when present. Schema must be backward-compatible (fields optional, missing = Sonnet-only row). This is the foundational schema change that unlocks shadow logging.
